summary: The eleven Miami dossiers are mostly sound on long-established history (Overtown, Calle Ocho, Wynwood Walls, Freedom Tower, Joe's, Versailles) and their Heat facts match the verified current facts (Giannis trade, 43-39 record, Play-In loss to Charlotte, Christmas at Boston, Nov 18 and Jan 28, Cup East Group B). I corrected 15 claims: the Presidents' Day home team, Panthers streak, Telemundo location, Wade and Jordan Brand framing, the Vice-era City Edition years, an expired August tax-window hook, and several unsupported names and roles (Sanguich founders, Ghee, Haslem broadcasting, Bam Nike alignment). Live checks confirmed Club Space, Shoe Gallery and the Little Haiti Cultural Complex are operating. The remaining risk is small-business status, partner ownership claims, Giannis jersey number, the Heat home opener, the unannounced 2026-27 City Edition, and strategy timing that ignores design lead times and passed windows (Carnival, Hispanic Heritage Month, Oct 15 launch).
